items_flat.title_en: Anthropic gives METR employee-like access for independent risk evaluations
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 給予 METR 員工級權限進行獨立風險評估
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced it has onboarded six METR researchers with company hardware, office space, and internal tool access comparable to its own risk teams. METR can publish assessments without Anthropic veto, subject only to narrow predefined redactions for customer data, privileged information, and certain architecture details.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布已讓六名 METR 研究人員獲得公司硬體、辦公空間，以及與自身風險團隊相當的內部工具存取權。METR 可發布評估結果，Anthropic 無權否決，僅限於客戶資料、特權資訊及特定架構細節的預先定義範圍內進行窄幅遮罩。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is the most concrete step yet by a frontier lab toward external verification of internal risk processes. Whether METR’s findings remain meaningfully independent once embedded remains the key uncertainty.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是前沿實驗室朝向外部驗證內部風險流程迄今最具體的一步。一旦嵌入後，METR 的發現能否保持有意義的獨立性，仍是關鍵不確定因素。
items_flat.quote: Outside a small number of clearly defined categories (e.g., data about customers, attorney-client privileged information, or information about our model architectures), Anthropic employees are encouraged to share information with them just as they would with a fellow employee working on alignment risk.
items_flat.quote_zh: 除了少數明確定義的類別（例如客戶資料、律師客戶特權資訊，或關於我們模型架構的資訊）外，Anthropic 員工被鼓勵與他們分享資訊，如同與從事對齊風險的同事一樣。

items_flat.title_en: Meta releases Muse Spark Open, 816B open-weight agentic model runnable on Mac Studios
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 發布 Muse Spark Open，816B 開源權重代理模型可於 Mac Studios 運行
items_flat.summary_en: Meta released the weights for Muse Spark Open, described as the most capable US open-weight model to date: natively multimodal, 816B total / 42B active parameters, 1M-token context, built for coding and long-horizon agentic work. It is optimized to run on two Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios via MLX, with weights under the Muse Model License.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta 發布 Muse Spark Open 權重，稱其為迄今最強大的美國開源權重模型：原生多模態、總參數 816B／活躍 42B、100 萬 token 上下文，專為編碼與長程代理工作打造。優化可於兩台 Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios 透過 MLX 運行，權重採 Muse Model License。
items_flat.analysis_en: A large open-weight agentic model that runs on high-end consumer hardware narrows the gap between closed frontier systems and local deployment. License terms and real-world agent reliability will determine adoption.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 可在高階消費級硬體上運行的大型開源權重代理模型，縮小了封閉前沿系統與本地部署之間的差距。授權條款與真實世界代理可靠性將決定採用程度。
items_flat.quote: Muse Spark Open is available today and brings leading agentic capabilities to your desktop for the first time on Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios.
items_flat.quote_zh: Muse Spark Open 今日可用，首次將領先的代理能力帶到 Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios 的桌面。

items_flat.title_en: FTC issues civil subpoenas to OpenAI and Anthropic over AI safety incidents
items_flat.title_zh: FTC 向 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 發出民事傳票，調查 AI 安全事件
items_flat.summary_en: The US Federal Trade Commission sent lengthy civil investigative demands to OpenAI and Anthropic seeking documents on security incidents, safeguards, marketing materials, and privacy policies, as part of a probe into potential consumer-protection violations after publicized agentic incidents.
items_flat.summary_zh: 美國聯邦貿易委員會向 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 發出冗長民事調查要求，索取安全事件、防護措施、行銷材料與隱私政策文件，作為針對潛在消費者保護違規的調查，背景為公開的代理事件。
items_flat.analysis_en: Regulatory scrutiny is shifting from voluntary commitments to formal information demands after publicized agentic incidents. The outcome depends on what the FTC finds in internal records.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 在公開的代理事件後，監管審查正從自願承諾轉向正式資訊要求。結果取決於 FTC 在內部紀錄中發現什麼。
items_flat.quote: We will engage constructively with the FTC and continue working with regulators and policymakers on policies that raise the safety bar.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們將建設性配合 FTC，並繼續與監管者與政策制定者合作，提升安全標準的政策。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic reports agents working 6x employee hours and hiring shifts toward judgment
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 報告代理工時為員工 6 倍，招聘轉向判斷力
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic published two research reports showing that by August 2026 interactive AI agent hours outnumbered employee hours 6 to 1, coinciding with a sharp drop in the share of junior technical hires (from 27% to 9%) and a shift toward roles emphasizing autonomy and judgment. Output per person rose across engineering, sales, and legal as agents diffused.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 發布兩份研究報告，顯示到 2026 年 8 月，互動式 AI 代理工時已是員工的 6 倍，同時初級技術招聘占比從 27% 驟降至 9%，招聘重點轉向自主性與判斷力。隨著代理擴散，工程、銷售與法務的人均產出上升。
items_flat.analysis_en: Internal telemetry from a frontier lab provides rare concrete data on agent adoption at scale, but it remains unclear how transferable the hiring and productivity patterns are to other organizations.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 前沿實驗室的內部遙測提供了代理大規模採用的罕見具體數據，但這些招聘與生產力模式能多大程度轉移到其他組織，仍不明確。
items_flat.quote: By August interactive AI agent hours outnumbered employees’ 6 to 1.
items_flat.quote_zh: 到 8 月，互動式 AI 代理工時已是員工的 6 倍。

items_flat.title_en: Reflection AI releases Beam open-weight 501B MoE model under Apache 2.0
items_flat.title_zh: Reflection AI 以 Apache 2.0 發布 Beam 開源權重 501B MoE 模型
items_flat.summary_en: Reflection AI released the weights for Beam, its first open-weight model: a sparse MoE with 501B total / 23B active parameters and 1M-token context, optimized for coding and agentic workloads. Weights, model card, and safety report are available on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0, with day-zero support across major inference engines and partners.
items_flat.summary_zh: Reflection AI 發布其首個開源權重模型 Beam 的權重：稀疏 MoE，總參數 501B／活躍 23B，100 萬 token 上下文，優化用於編碼與代理工作負載。權重、模型卡與安全報告可於 Hugging Face 以 Apache 2.0 取得，並獲主要推理引擎與合作夥伴的即日支援。
items_flat.analysis_en: An Apache-licensed US open-weight model focused on inference efficiency rather than raw parameter count offers a concrete alternative to larger Chinese open models for agentic coding.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 以 Apache 授權、聚焦推理效率而非原始參數量的美國開源權重模型，為代理編碼提供了相對於較大中國開源模型的具體替代方案。
items_flat.quote: Beam is our first open-weight model, built for advanced coding, reasoning, and long-horizon agentic workloads with frontier reasoning efficiency. Today, we have released Beam’s model weights on Hugging Face under an Apache 2.0 license.
items_flat.quote_zh: Beam 是我們的第一個開源權重模型，專為先進編碼、推理與長程代理工作負載打造，具備前沿推理效率。今日，我們已於 Hugging Face 以 Apache 2.0 授權發布 Beam 的模型權重。

items_flat.title_en: Simons Foundation, OpenAI and Anthropic commit $15M to help mathematicians navigate AI results
items_flat.title_zh: Simons Foundation、OpenAI 與 Anthropic 承諾 1500 萬美元協助數學家應對 AI 結果
items_flat.summary_en: The Simons Foundation announced a partnership with Anthropic and OpenAI committing $15 million in combined funding and resources. The foundation will manage grants for workshops and initiatives that help researchers evaluate AI-assisted mathematical results and develop shared standards.
items_flat.summary_zh: Simons Foundation 宣布與 Anthropic 及 OpenAI 合作，承諾合計 1500 萬美元資金與資源。基金會將管理補助，支持工作坊與計畫，協助研究人員評估 AI 輔助的數學結果並發展共享標準。
items_flat.analysis_en: The initiative responds to community unease after recent AI-generated mathematical results. Its value will rest on whether it produces durable verification practices and shared norms.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此倡議回應近期 AI 生成數學結果後社群的不安。其價值取決於能否產生持久的驗證實踐與共享規範。
items_flat.quote: As artificial intelligence rapidly reshapes the research landscape, we want to help the mathematical community come together and forge the best path forward.
items_flat.quote_zh: 隨著人工智慧迅速重塑研究格局，我們希望協助數學社群聚在一起，開創最佳前進路徑。

items_flat.title_en: xAI releases Grok Voice 3.0 speech-to-speech model
items_flat.title_zh: xAI 發布 Grok Voice 3.0 語音對語音模型
items_flat.summary_en: xAI announced Grok Voice 3.0, its latest speech-to-speech model, claiming top ranking on Artificial Analysis’s Speech-to-Speech Index (86.9) and strong full-duplex performance. It is available in the Voice Agent API at the same $0.08/min pricing as prior versions.
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI 宣布其最新語音對語音模型 Grok Voice 3.0，聲稱在 Artificial Analysis 的語音對語音指數排名第一（86.9），並具備強大全雙工性能。於 Voice Agent API 提供，定價與先前版本相同為每分鐘 0.08 美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: Voice remains a competitive surface where latency, interruption handling, and real-world task completion matter more than pure benchmark leadership. Sustained advantage will depend on measured real-world performance.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 語音仍是競爭領域，延遲、中斷處理與真實世界任務完成度比純粹基準領先更重要。持續優勢取決於實測的真實世界表現。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re announcing Grok Voice 3.0, the world’s most intelligent speech-to-speech model. It sets a new record for resolving customer support calls, has class-leading latency at under one second, and costs less than other frontier models.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們宣布 Grok Voice 3.0，世界上最智慧的語音對語音模型。它在解決客服通話上創下新紀錄，具有低於一秒的領先延遲，且成本低於其他前線模型。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI adds parallel agents to GPT-6 Astra Pro in ChatGPT and launches ChatGPT Slides
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 為 ChatGPT 中的 GPT-6 Astra Pro 新增平行代理，並推出 ChatGPT Slides
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced an upgrade to GPT-6 Astra Pro in ChatGPT that enables multiple agents to tackle different parts of a task in parallel, with per-agent progress tracking and the ability to open completed tasks for review. On the same day it launched ChatGPT Slides for creating, editing, presenting, and collaborating on decks with real-time team editing and export options.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布升級 ChatGPT 中的 GPT-6 Astra Pro，允許多個代理平行處理任務的不同部分，可追蹤各代理進度並開啟完成任務以檢視。同日推出 ChatGPT Slides，支援建立、編輯、呈現與協作簡報，含即時團隊編輯與匯出選項。
items_flat.analysis_en: Parallel agent orchestration moves from API-level experimentation into a consumer ChatGPT surface for Pro users. Real-world reliability will depend on how well the system surfaces conflicts and intermediate results.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 平行代理編排從 API 層級實驗進入消費級 ChatGPT 的 Pro 用戶介面。真實世界可靠性取決於系統如何呈現衝突與中間結果。
items_flat.quote: And now, multiple agents can tackle different parts of a task in parallel. You can follow each agent’s progress and open completed tasks to review their work.
items_flat.quote_zh: 現在，多個代理可以平行處理任務的不同部分。你可以追蹤每個代理的進度，並開啟完成的任務以檢視其工作。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA releases Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, 120B open multimodal agent model
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA 發布 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL，120B 開源多模態代理模型
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120B-total / 12B-active parameter multimodal MoE model designed for always-on specialized agents, along with smaller Bolt edge variants. Weights, datasets, and recipes are available under an open license for customization across NVIDIA hardware.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA 發布 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL，這是開放的 120B 總參數／12B 活躍參數多模態 MoE 模型，專為常開專業代理設計，並附較小的 Bolt 邊緣變體。權重、數據集與配方可於開放授權下取得，供 NVIDIA 硬體客製化。
items_flat.analysis_en: NVIDIA’s open multimodal agent model targets the growing demand for specialized, always-on agents that can be customized and run across its hardware stack. Whether post-trained versions deliver durable gains remains to be seen.
items_flat.analysis_zh: NVIDIA 的開源多模態代理模型針對日益增長的專業、常開代理需求，可客製並在其硬體堆疊上運行。後訓練版本能否帶來持久增益仍待觀察。
items_flat.quote: NVIDIA today released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120-billion-parameter model that delivers the fastest task completion and highest accuracy for specialized always-on agents.
items_flat.quote_zh: NVIDIA 今日發布 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL，這是開放的 1200 億參數模型，為專業常開代理提供最快任務完成與最高準確度。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI rolls out GPT-Live-1.1 and new multilingual voices in ChatGPT
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT 推出 GPT-Live-1.1 與新多語言語音
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI is rolling out GPT-Live-1.1 and the smaller GPT-Live-1.1 Quip in ChatGPT Voice. The update adds more natural accents across languages and a wider range of short phrases when searching. New voices cover French, German, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, and Mexican Spanish.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 正在 ChatGPT Voice 推出 GPT-Live-1.1 與較小的 GPT-Live-1.1 Quip。更新增加跨語言更自然的口音，以及搜尋時更廣泛的短語。新語音涵蓋法語、德語、印地語、日語、韓語與墨西哥西班牙語。
items_flat.analysis_en: Voice model iteration continues to focus on naturalness and language coverage rather than headline capability jumps. Real gains for multilingual users depend on measured improvements in interruption handling and task completion.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 語音模型迭代持續聚焦自然度與語言覆蓋，而非頭條能力躍升。多語言用戶的真實增益取決於中斷處理與任務完成的實測改善。
items_flat.quote: We’re rolling out GPT‑Live‑1.1 and GPT‑Live‑1.1 Quip, a mini version of the model, in ChatGPT Voice, with more natural accents across languages.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們正在 ChatGPT Voice 推出 GPT‑Live‑1.1 與模型的迷你版 GPT‑Live‑1.1 Quip，具備跨語言更自然的口音。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind plans new robotics hardware lab in the Cambridge area
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 計畫於劍橋地區建立新機器人硬體實驗室
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind VP of hardware engineering Aaron Saunders (formerly Boston Dynamics CTO) announced on LinkedIn that the company is creating a first-class lab to house a growing hardware team developing robotics that builds on DeepMind’s AI research. Reports place the facility in the Cambridge/Watertown area with completion targeted for 2027.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 硬體工程副總裁 Aaron Saunders（前 Boston Dynamics CTO）於 LinkedIn 宣布，公司正在建立一流實驗室，容納不斷壯大的硬體團隊，開發建立在 DeepMind AI 研究之上的機器人。報導指出設施位於劍橋／Watertown 地區，目標 2027 年完工。
items_flat.analysis_en: The move signals continued investment in embodied AI after Gemini robotics efforts and the Intrinsic absorption. Concrete capability impact remains uncertain until the lab is operational.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉顯示在 Gemini 機器人努力與 Intrinsic 整合後，對具身 AI 的持續投資。在實驗室運作前，具體能力影響仍不確定。
items_flat.quote: We’re creating a first-class lab to house this team and take robotics to the next level.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們正在建立一流實驗室來容納這個團隊，並將機器人技術提升到下一個層次。

openai.title_en: OpenAI adds parallel agents to GPT-6 Astra Pro in ChatGPT and launches ChatGPT Slides

anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 發布兩份研究報告，顯示到 2026 年 8 月，互動式 AI 代理工時已是員工的 6 倍，同時初級技術招聘占比從 27% 驟降至 9%，招聘重點轉向自主性與判斷力。隨著代理擴散，工程、銷售與法務的人均產出上升。
anthropic.analysis_en: Internal telemetry from a frontier lab provides rare concrete data on agent adoption at scale, but it remains unclear how transferable the hiring and productivity patterns are to other organizations.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 前沿實驗室的內部遙測提供了代理大規模採用的罕見具體數據，但這些招聘與生產力模式能多大程度轉移到其他組織，仍不明確。
anthropic.quote: By August interactive AI agent hours outnumbered employees’ 6 to 1.
anthropic.quote_zh: 到 8 月，互動式 AI 代理工時已是員工的 6 倍。

google.title_en: Google DeepMind plans new robotics hardware lab in the Cambridge area
google.title_zh: Google DeepMind 計畫於劍橋地區建立新機器人硬體實驗室
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind VP of hardware engineering Aaron Saunders (formerly Boston Dynamics CTO) announced on LinkedIn that the company is creating a first-class lab to house a growing hardware team developing robotics that builds on DeepMind’s AI research. Reports place the facility in the Cambridge/Watertown area with completion targeted for 2027.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 硬體工程副總裁 Aaron Saunders（前 Boston Dynamics CTO）於 LinkedIn 宣布，公司正在建立一流實驗室，容納不斷壯大的硬體團隊，開發建立在 DeepMind AI 研究之上的機器人。報導指出設施位於劍橋／Watertown 地區，目標 2027 年完工。
google.analysis_en: The move signals continued investment in embodied AI after Gemini robotics efforts and the Intrinsic absorption. Concrete capability impact remains uncertain until the lab is operational.
google.analysis_zh: 此舉顯示在 Gemini 機器人努力與 Intrinsic 整合後，對具身 AI 的持續投資。在實驗室運作前，具體能力影響仍不確定。
google.quote: We’re creating a first-class lab to house this team and take robotics to the next level.
google.quote_zh: 我們正在建立一流實驗室來容納這個團隊，並將機器人技術提升到下一個層次。

meta.title_en: Meta releases Muse Spark Open, 816B open-weight agentic model runnable on Mac Studios
meta.title_zh: Meta 發布 Muse Spark Open，816B 開源權重代理模型可於 Mac Studios 運行
meta.summary_en: Meta released the weights for Muse Spark Open, described as the most capable US open-weight model to date: natively multimodal, 816B total / 42B active parameters, 1M-token context, built for coding and long-horizon agentic work. It is optimized to run on two Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios via MLX, with weights under the Muse Model License.
meta.summary_zh: Meta 發布 Muse Spark Open 權重，稱其為迄今最強大的美國開源權重模型：原生多模態、總參數 816B／活躍 42B、100 萬 token 上下文，專為編碼與長程代理工作打造。優化可於兩台 Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios 透過 MLX 運行，權重採 Muse Model License。
meta.analysis_en: A large open-weight agentic model that runs on high-end consumer hardware narrows the gap between closed frontier systems and local deployment. License terms and real-world agent reliability will determine adoption.
meta.analysis_zh: 可在高階消費級硬體上運行的大型開源權重代理模型，縮小了封閉前沿系統與本地部署之間的差距。授權條款與真實世界代理可靠性將決定採用程度。
meta.quote: Muse Spark Open is available today and brings leading agentic capabilities to your desktop for the first time on Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios.
meta.quote_zh: Muse Spark Open 今日可用，首次將領先的代理能力帶到 Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios 的桌面。

xai.title_en: xAI releases Grok Voice 3.0 speech-to-speech model
xai.title_zh: xAI 發布 Grok Voice 3.0 語音對語音模型
xai.summary_en: xAI announced Grok Voice 3.0, its latest speech-to-speech model, claiming top ranking on Artificial Analysis’s Speech-to-Speech Index (86.9) and strong full-duplex performance. It is available in the Voice Agent API at the same $0.08/min pricing as prior versions.
xai.summary_zh: xAI 宣布其最新語音對語音模型 Grok Voice 3.0，聲稱在 Artificial Analysis 的語音對語音指數排名第一（86.9），並具備強大全雙工性能。於 Voice Agent API 提供，定價與先前版本相同為每分鐘 0.08 美元。
xai.analysis_en: Voice remains a competitive surface where latency, interruption handling, and real-world task completion matter more than pure benchmark leadership. Sustained advantage will depend on measured real-world performance.
xai.analysis_zh: 語音仍是競爭領域，延遲、中斷處理與真實世界任務完成度比純粹基準領先更重要。持續優勢取決於實測的真實世界表現。
xai.quote: Today, we’re announcing Grok Voice 3.0, the world’s most intelligent speech-to-speech model. It sets a new record for resolving customer support calls, has class-leading latency at under one second, and costs less than other frontier models.
xai.quote_zh: 今天我們宣布 Grok Voice 3.0，世界上最智慧的語音對語音模型。它在解決客服通話上創下新紀錄，具有低於一秒的領先延遲，且成本低於其他前線模型。

frontier_other.title_en: FTC issues civil subpoenas to OpenAI and Anthropic over AI safety incidents
frontier_other.title_zh: FTC 向 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 發出民事傳票，調查 AI 安全事件
frontier_other.summary_en: The US Federal Trade Commission sent lengthy civil investigative demands to OpenAI and Anthropic seeking documents on security incidents, safeguards, marketing materials, and privacy policies, as part of a probe into potential consumer-protection violations after publicized agentic incidents.
frontier_other.summary_zh: 美國聯邦貿易委員會向 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 發出冗長民事調查要求，索取安全事件、防護措施、行銷材料與隱私政策文件，作為針對潛在消費者保護違規的調查，背景為公開的代理事件。
frontier_other.analysis_en: Regulatory scrutiny is shifting from voluntary commitments to formal information demands after publicized agentic incidents. The outcome depends on what the FTC finds in internal records.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 在公開的代理事件後，監管審查正從自願承諾轉向正式資訊要求。結果取決於 FTC 在內部紀錄中發現什麼。
frontier_other.quote: We will engage constructively with the FTC and continue working with regulators and policymakers on policies that raise the safety bar.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 我們將建設性配合 FTC，並繼續與監管者與政策制定者合作，提升安全標準的政策。

frontier_other.title_en: Reflection AI releases Beam open-weight 501B MoE model under Apache 2.0
frontier_other.title_zh: Reflection AI 以 Apache 2.0 發布 Beam 開源權重 501B MoE 模型
frontier_other.summary_en: Reflection AI released the weights for Beam, its first open-weight model: a sparse MoE with 501B total / 23B active parameters and 1M-token context, optimized for coding and agentic workloads. Weights, model card, and safety report are available on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0, with day-zero support across major inference engines and partners.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Reflection AI 發布其首個開源權重模型 Beam 的權重：稀疏 MoE，總參數 501B／活躍 23B，100 萬 token 上下文，優化用於編碼與代理工作負載。權重、模型卡與安全報告可於 Hugging Face 以 Apache 2.0 取得，並獲主要推理引擎與合作夥伴的即日支援。
frontier_other.analysis_en: An Apache-licensed US open-weight model focused on inference efficiency rather than raw parameter count offers a concrete alternative to larger Chinese open models for agentic coding.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 以 Apache 授權、聚焦推理效率而非原始參數量的美國開源權重模型，為代理編碼提供了相對於較大中國開源模型的具體替代方案。
frontier_other.quote: Beam is our first open-weight model, built for advanced coding, reasoning, and long-horizon agentic workloads with frontier reasoning efficiency. Today, we have released Beam’s model weights on Hugging Face under an Apache 2.0 license.
frontier_other.quote_zh: Beam 是我們的第一個開源權重模型，專為先進編碼、推理與長程代理工作負載打造，具備前沿推理效率。今日，我們已於 Hugging Face 以 Apache 2.0 授權發布 Beam 的模型權重。

frontier_other.title_en: Simons Foundation, OpenAI and Anthropic commit $15M to help mathematicians navigate AI results
frontier_other.title_zh: Simons Foundation、OpenAI 與 Anthropic 承諾 1500 萬美元協助數學家應對 AI 結果
frontier_other.summary_en: The Simons Foundation announced a partnership with Anthropic and OpenAI committing $15 million in combined funding and resources. The foundation will manage grants for workshops and initiatives that help researchers evaluate AI-assisted mathematical results and develop shared standards.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Simons Foundation 宣布與 Anthropic 及 OpenAI 合作，承諾合計 1500 萬美元資金與資源。基金會將管理補助，支持工作坊與計畫，協助研究人員評估 AI 輔助的數學結果並發展共享標準。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The initiative responds to community unease after recent AI-generated mathematical results. Its value will rest on whether it produces durable verification practices and shared norms.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 此倡議回應近期 AI 生成數學結果後社群的不安。其價值取決於能否產生持久的驗證實踐與共享規範。
frontier_other.quote: As artificial intelligence rapidly reshapes the research landscape, we want to help the mathematical community come together and forge the best path forward.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 隨著人工智慧迅速重塑研究格局，我們希望協助數學社群聚在一起，開創最佳前進路徑。

frontier_other.title_en: NVIDIA releases Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, 120B open multimodal agent model
frontier_other.title_zh: NVIDIA 發布 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL，120B 開源多模態代理模型
frontier_other.summary_en: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120B-total / 12B-active parameter multimodal MoE model designed for always-on specialized agents, along with smaller Bolt edge variants. Weights, datasets, and recipes are available under an open license for customization across NVIDIA hardware.
frontier_other.summary_zh: NVIDIA 發布 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL，這是開放的 120B 總參數／12B 活躍參數多模態 MoE 模型，專為常開專業代理設計，並附較小的 Bolt 邊緣變體。權重、數據集與配方可於開放授權下取得，供 NVIDIA 硬體客製化。
frontier_other.analysis_en: NVIDIA’s open multimodal agent model targets the growing demand for specialized, always-on agents that can be customized and run across its hardware stack. Whether post-trained versions deliver durable gains remains to be seen.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: NVIDIA 的開源多模態代理模型針對日益增長的專業、常開代理需求，可客製並在其硬體堆疊上運行。後訓練版本能否帶來持久增益仍待觀察。
frontier_other.quote: NVIDIA today released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120-billion-parameter model that delivers the fastest task completion and highest accuracy for specialized always-on agents.
frontier_other.quote_zh: NVIDIA 今日發布 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL，這是開放的 1200 億參數模型，為專業常開代理提供最快任務完成與最高準確度。

brief_en: Frontier labs advanced open-weight agents, published internal employment data showing agent hours outpacing staff, faced FTC scrutiny, and shipped product upgrades including parallel agents and voice models.
brief_zh: 前沿實驗室推進開源權重代理模型，公布內部就業數據顯示代理工時超越員工，面對FTC審查，並推出平行代理與語音模型等產品升級。
